content.text:
Here are some **free online auto repair estimate** options, depending on what you need:

### Mechanical repair estimates
- **YourMechanic Instant Estimates** — free estimates by vehicle, repair type, and location. Good for brakes, alternator, starter, oil leaks, tune-ups, etc. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))
- **MotorMate** — free online tool for repair cost estimates. ([motormateapp.com](https://motormateapp.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **AutoAssist AI** — free repair-estimate and car-help tool, including code/diagnostic help. ([autoassist.help](https://autoassist.help/?utm_source=openai))

### Collision / body repair estimates
- **Instant Estimator** — free auto body repair estimator; can submit photos for a more precise quote. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **VTCCO** — free AI estimate from uploaded damage photos for collision/body damage. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **CarAid** — estimates from photos, with AI plus human review; offers a free slower option. ([caraid.us](https://www.caraid.us/?utm_source=openai))

### Best way to get a realistic number
Online tools are good for a **ballpark**, but actual prices vary by your ZIP code, labor rate, parts choice, and hidden damage. For the most accurate quote, get **2–3 local shop estimates** and ask for the estimate broken down by **parts, labor hours, labor rate, shop supplies, taxes, and diagnostics**.

If you tell me your **year/make/model**, **ZIP code**, and what repair you need — or upload/describe the damage — I can help you estimate the likely cost range.
